ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO :

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 20-F in the area bound by :

       West 87th Street; a line 138.18 feet east of and parallel to South Normal Avenue; a line
       270 feet north of and parallel to West 87th Street; a line 296.39 feet in southeasterly
       direction starting at a point 393.94 east of and parallel to South Normal Avenue and
       ending at a point 512.61 feet east of and parallel to South Normal Avenue

to those of a RS-2, Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




Common Address:
440 W. 87 1h Street
